high_level_description: The image depicts two women sitting on a bench against a tiled wall with a barred window above them. The woman on the left is wearing a dark purple dress with a matching shawl draped over her shoulders. She has her hands clasped together and appears to be looking down at her lap. The woman on the right is dressed in a light beige or cream-colored dress with a similar shawl, also draped over her shoulders. Her hands are also clasped together, and she looks downward as well.
